question: Which of the following dynasty ruled India for only fifteen years?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sur Dynasty**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Sur Dynasty** ruled India for a brief period of only **15 years**, from **1540 to 1555**. It was established by **Sher Shah Suri**, a prominent ruler known for his administrative reforms and military strategies.
 
• **Sher Shah Suri** defeated the Mughal emperor Humayun at the **Battle of Kannauj (1540)** and effectively ended Mughal rule temporarily during his reign.
 
• The Sur Dynasty is celebrated for initiating notable reforms, such as the introduction of the **Rupiya (currency)** and significant improvements in **road infrastructure**, including the construction of the **Grand Trunk Road**.
 
• The Sur Empire declined after the death of Sher Shah in **1545**, with a series of weak successors unable to hold the empire together. Humayun regained the throne in **1555**, marking the end of the Sur Dynasty.
 
• The Sur Dynasty ruled primarily over northern India, extending its influence to parts of present-day Pakistan and Afgh
